description: Lets the main window's bundled local UI (manager-shell/'s built output -- see main.rs and tauri.conf.json's frontendDist) invoke the remember_broker/forget_broker/api_request/api_request_multipart commands the window.vyxDesktop bridge wraps. No `remote` block -- the window only ever loads local content now (all real network traffic goes through the api_request bridge's own reqwest::Client, not the WebView's).
